items.title: Itabirito (MG) Education procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #638
items.en_title: Itabirito (MG) Education procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 1 #638
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Itabirito (MG) is procuring education-related goods or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 2,655,200; proposals close Dec 1, 18:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
